name: prompt-analyzer
description: Review a prompt before you send it: quality score, unclear wording, missing context, skills to use, and an improved version

MODEL.title: Analysis model
MODEL.description: Model that reviews your prompts: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. Each analysis is one separate call; it never enters your conversation.

INCLUDE_CONVERSATION.title: Send recent conversation
INCLUDE_CONVERSATION.description: Give the reviewer the last few messages, so it can tell whether "it" or "that bug" is clear from context.

PLAIN.title: Explain in plain English (/plain)
PLAIN.description: Write the review's explanations with the rules of the /plain skill (Simplified Technical English), when that skill is installed. The improved prompt keeps your own voice.
